description: This Java configuration class sets up a batch job for adding accrual transactions for savings accounts in the Fineract platform. It defines beans for a step, a job, and a tasklet related to the accrual process.

classes.name: AddAccrualTransactionForSavingsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up a batch job to add accrual transactions for savings accounts.

methods.name: addAccrualTransactionForSavingsStep
methods.description: Defines a batch step for executing the accrual transaction tasklet.

methods.name: addAccrualTransactionForSavingsJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that runs the savings accrual process, starting with the specified step.

methods.name: addAccrualTransactionForSavingsTasklet
methods.description: Creates an instance of the tasklet responsible for performing the accrual transaction logic.
